widgetsIntro: Next appointment, check-in and today's medications right on your home screen. Long-press the home screen → Widgets → Ärzte.
widgetsAutoDiscreet: Currently discreet because the app lock is on.
widgetsAutoDetailed: Currently showing details. Discreet automatically with the app lock.
widgetsDiscreetText: Only times and counts – no names of doctors, medications or symptoms.
widgetsDetailedText: Shows doctor, appointment title, medications and symptom – visible to anyone who sees your home screen.
widgetsWatchIntro: Next appointment, today's medications and check-in on your Apple Watch: as a complication on the watch face and in the Ärzte watch app. Data only goes directly to your paired watch.
widgetsWatchHint: Also applies to the tiles and complications of the Ärzte watch app on your Wear OS watch. Data only goes to paired watches that have the watch app installed.
